newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: RUGBY UNION-S.AFRICA CALL UP UNCAPPED BACKS.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-S.AFRICA CALL UP UNCAPPED BACKS.

text.p: Uncapped Western Province backs Percival Montgomery and Pieter Rossouw have been drafted into a new-look South African back division for the second test against the British Lions in Durban on Saturday.

The pair are joined by recalled Northern Transvaal centre Danie van Schalkwyk in the only three changes -- all of them forced by injury -- made by coach Carel du Plessis from the side which lost the first test in Cape Town, 25-16.
Montgomery, 23, forms a new centre pairing with van Schalkwyk, 22, who scored two tries for Northern Transvaal in the Lions' solitary defeat in their 10 tour matches to date.
Rossouw, 25, takes the left wing berth while Andre Snyman, 23, swaps over to the right. The Springbok centres and wings will have just 10 test caps between them.

Du Plessis has had to remodel the back division in the absence of centres Edrich Lubbe and Japie Mulder as well as wing James Small. Only Mulder is expected to recover from his shoulder injury in time to play in the third test on July 5.
But du Plessis said: "I don't think the backline is inexperienced. Both Danie van Schalkwyk and Percial Montgomery have played at the top level this season but it will be a test for them.
"I believe they can lift themselves -- the ultimate test is to take that step up to test level.
"We also have to introduce youngsters to the line-up with minimum risk. In the end I had to make changes because of injury but the players coming in I believe are very strong."

Du Plessis otherwise retains the 12 fit players from the first test. He confirmed he had spoken to dropped World Cup winning centre Hennie le Roux on Tuesday but the Gauteng Lions player had ruled himself out because of a groin strain.
"He has been struggling with a niggling injury and I appreciate his honesty," said du Plessis.

South Africa - 15-Andre Joubert, 14-Andre Snyman, 13-Percival Montgomery, 12-Danie van Schalkwyk, 11-Pieter Rossouw, 10-Henry Honiball, 9-Joost van der Westhuizen, 8-Gary Teichmann (captain), 7-Andre Venter, 6-Ruben Kruger, 5-Hannes Strydom, 4-Mark Anrews, 3-Adrian Garvey, 2-Naka Drotske, 1-Os du Randt.
Replacements: Russell Bennett, Boeta Wessels, Werner Swanepoel, James Dalton, Dawie Theron, Fritz van Heerden.
